## Data Prep 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(devtools)
library(fixest)   # for TWFE
library(did)      # for Callaway-Sant'Anna DiD
library(car)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(knitr)

# Load data (adjust path if needed)
panel <- readRDS("data/output/MAIN_panel_data.rds")

# Basic cleaning / type setting -----------------------------------------------

panel <- panel %>% mutate(across(
    c(country_id, country_code, year, regime_type_2, regime_type_4, regime_type_10, 
      aut_ep, dem_ep, regch_event, regch_genuine, aut_cohort), as.factor))

panel$regime_type_4 <- factor(panel$regime_type_4, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3"))

# number of NAs for each control variable using colSums and is.na
colSums(is.na(panel %>% 
                select(elect_dem, lib_dem, spi_overall, log_gdppc, log_pop, 
                       luminosity, electric_access, rural_pop_pct)))
```


# APPROACH 1.1: Two‑way fixed effects (TWFE) for goal-level missingness outcomes
```{r}
# Goal-Level TWFE models: EDI -> missingness by SDG goal ---------------------

# Vector of your SDG goal-level missingness variables
sdg_vars <- paste0("prop_miss_SDG", 1:17)

# Quick check that they really exist
sdg_vars[!sdg_vars %in% names(panel)] # If character(0), all 17 are present.

# Function to run one TWFE model for each SDG goal 
run_goal_twfe <- function(var_name) {
  feols(as.formula(paste0(var_name, 
       " ~ l(aut_ep, 0:2) + log_pop + electric_access + I(electric_access^2) + log_luminosity + rural_pop_pct",
       " | country_code + year")), 
       data = panel, 
       panel.id = ~ country_code + year, 
       cluster = ~ country_code)
}

# Run TWFE for each SDG goal-level missingness variable
twfe_goal_models <- map(sdg_vars, run_goal_twfe)

# assign names to each model
names(twfe_goal_models) <- sdg_vars

# Extracting the coefficients and standard errors for the aut_ep lags from each model

goal_effects <- map_dfr(
  sdg_vars,
  ~ {
    m  <- twfe_goal_models[[.x]]
    ct <- summary(m)$coeftable
    rn <- rownames(ct)

    idx_t   <- grep("^l\\(aut_ep, 0\\)", rn)
    idx_t1  <- grep("^l\\(aut_ep, 1\\)", rn)
    idx_t2  <- grep("^l\\(aut_ep, 2\\)", rn)

    beta_t   <- ct[idx_t,  "Estimate"];  se_t   <- ct[idx_t,  "Std. Error"];  p_t   <- ct[idx_t,  "Pr(>|t|)"]
    beta_t1  <- ct[idx_t1, "Estimate"];  se_t1  <- ct[idx_t1, "Std. Error"]; p_t1  <- ct[idx_t1, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    beta_t2  <- ct[idx_t2, "Estimate"];  se_t2  <- ct[idx_t2, "Std. Error"]; p_t2  <- ct[idx_t2, "Pr(>|t|)"]

    tibble(
      sdg     = .x,
      beta_t,  se_t,  p_t,
      star_t  = case_when(
        p_t < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_t < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_t < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_t < 0.1   ~ ".",
        TRUE        ~ ""
      ),
      beta_t1, se_t1, p_t1,
      star_t1 = case_when(
        p_t1 < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_t1 < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_t1 < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_t1 < 0.1   ~ ".",
        TRUE         ~ ""
      ),
      beta_t2, se_t2, p_t2,
      star_t2 = case_when(
        p_t2 < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_t2 < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_t2 < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_t2 < 0.1   ~ ".",
        TRUE         ~ ""
      )
    )
  }
)
goal_effects

## Neat table of TWFE effects by goal 
goal_effects %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("beta"), ~ round(.x, 3)),
         across(starts_with("se"),   ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("SDG outcome",
                  "β_t", "SE_t", "p_t", "sig_t",
                  "β_{t-1}", "SE_{t-1}", "p_{t-1}", "sig_{t-1}",
                  "β_{t-2}", "SE_{t-2}", "p_{t-2}", "sig_{t-2}"),
    caption = "TWFE effects of autocratization (t, t−1, t−2) on SDG goal-level missingness"
  )
```


# TWFE models with only t−1 lag
```{r}
sdg_vars <- paste0("prop_miss_SDG", 1:17)

run_goal_twfe_l1 <- function(var_name) {
  feols(
    as.formula(paste0(
      var_name,
      " ~ l(aut_ep, 1) + log_pop + electric_access + I(electric_access^2) + log_luminosity + rural_pop_pct",
       " | country_code + year")),
    data = panel,
    panel.id = ~ country_code + year,
    cluster  = ~ country_code
  )
}

twfe_goal_models_l1 <- map(sdg_vars, run_goal_twfe_l1)
names(twfe_goal_models_l1) <- sdg_vars

# Extract coefficients, SEs, and p-values for the l(aut_ep, 1) term from each model
goal_effects_l1 <- map_dfr(
  sdg_vars,
  ~ {
    m  <- twfe_goal_models_l1[[.x]]
    ct <- summary(m)$coeftable
    rn <- rownames(ct)

    idx_l1 <- grep("^l\\(aut_ep, 1\\)", rn)

    beta_l1 <- ct[idx_l1, "Estimate"]
    se_l1   <- ct[idx_l1, "Std. Error"]
    p_l1    <- ct[idx_l1, "Pr(>|t|)"]

    tibble(
      sdg     = .x,
      beta_l1 = beta_l1,
      se_l1   = se_l1,
      p_l1    = p_l1,
      star_l1 = case_when(
        p_l1 < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_l1 < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_l1 < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_l1 < 0.1   ~ ".",
        TRUE         ~ ""
      )
    )
  }
)

goal_effects_l1

# table for t−1 effects only
goal_effects_l1 %>%
  mutate(
    beta_l1 = round(beta_l1, 3),
    se_l1   = round(se_l1, 3),
    p_l1    = round(p_l1, 3)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("SDG outcome",
                  "β (aut_ep, t−1)", "SE", "p‑value", "sig."),
    caption = "TWFE effect of lagged autocratization episode (t−1) on SDG goal-level missingness"
  )
```


# TWFE models with only t−2 lag
```{r}
library(fixest)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# SDG outcomes (same as before)
sdg_vars <- paste0("prop_miss_SDG", 1:17)

# Function: TWFE with only l(aut_ep, 2)
run_goal_twfe_l2 <- function(var_name) {
  feols(
    as.formula(paste0(
      var_name,
      " ~ l(aut_ep, 2) + log_pop + electric_access + I(electric_access^2) + log_luminosity + rural_pop_pct",
      " | country_code + year")), 
    data     = panel,
    panel.id = ~ country_code + year,
    cluster  = ~ country_code
  )
}

# Run models for all 17 SDG goals
twfe_goal_models_l2 <- map(sdg_vars, run_goal_twfe_l2)
names(twfe_goal_models_l2) <- sdg_vars

# Extract coefficients, SEs, and p-values for the l(aut_ep, 2) term from each model
goal_effects_l2 <- map_dfr(
  sdg_vars,
  ~ {
    m  <- twfe_goal_models_l2[[.x]]
    ct <- summary(m)$coeftable
    rn <- rownames(ct)

    idx_t2 <- grep("^l\\(aut_ep, 2\\)", rn)

    beta_t2 <- ct[idx_t2, "Estimate"]
    se_t2   <- ct[idx_t2, "Std. Error"]
    p_t2    <- ct[idx_t2, "Pr(>|t|)"]

    tibble(
      sdg     = .x,
      beta_t2 = beta_t2,
      se_t2   = se_t2,
      p_t2    = p_t2,
      star_t2 = case_when(
        p_t2 < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_t2 < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_t2 < 0.05  ~ "*",
        p_t2 < 0.1   ~ ".",
        TRUE         ~ ""
      )
    )
  }
)

goal_effects_l2

# table for t−2 effects only
goal_effects_l2 %>%
  mutate(
    beta_t2 = round(beta_t2, 3),
    se_t2   = round(se_t2, 3),
    p_t2    = round(p_t2, 3)
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("SDG outcome",
                  "β (aut_ep, t−2)", "SE (t−2)", "p (t−2)", "sig"),
    caption = "TWFE effects of second-lag autocratization episodes (t−2) on SDG goal-level missingness"
  )
```
